scripts.dev:electron: tsc electron/main.ts electron/preload.ts --outDir dist-electron --target es2020 --module commonjs --allowSyntheticDefaultImports --skipLibCheck && electron .
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "react,electron,backend" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:react" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm run dev:electron" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.build: tsc --skipLibCheck && vite build && tsc electron/main.ts electron/preload.ts --outDir dist-electron --skipLibCheck
